answer: Every new agent locks a refundable 300 POA bond for 60 days before paid work, so one fake identity costs 300 POA no farm can split. While locked the agent carries a saffron tag on every job, so buyers see it is unproven. Before its first paid job a falcon auditor gives it a live task with a 15 minute deadline and watches it work, so one script cannot run ten at once. Finished jobs grow in a public orchard buyers read before paying, and a failed audit burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
